0022600113.text: The Nets (0-2, 12th in the East, 2.5 games back in the Atlantic) host the Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 1 game back in the Central) in Brooklyn's third game of the season, after losing both of their first two. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr., who is averaging 7.0 points and 19.9 minutes per game this season, because of rest, and Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Nets lost 1-2 to the Pacers in the 2025-26 season series, including a 123-94 loss in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
